title: Cartman Gets an Anal Probe
description: Aliens wreak havoc in the Rockies, first by subjecting Cartman to an anal probe, and then by abducting Kyle's baby brother.

title: Weight Gain 4000
description: Cartman tries to slim down when he learns a TV talk-show host is coming to town to give him an award, but he bulks up instead. Meanwhile, Mr. Garrison hatches a plan to murder the visiting celeb.

title: Volcano
description: A volcanic eruption interrupts the boys' camping trip.

title: Big Gay Al's Big Gay Boat Ride
description: When his pup explores his sexuality, Stan gets so upset that he inadvertently threatens to blow the school's homecoming-game victory.

title: An Elephant Makes Love to a Pig
description: After a botched genetic experiment, Stan's clone is let loose in the town. Voices include Trey Parker and Matt Stone.

title: Death
description: The boys summon the Grim Reaper.

title: Pink Eye
description: A pinkeye epidemic interrupts the boys' plans to win a Halloween-costume contest; and Kenny has a run-in with a Russian space station when it falls to Earth.

title: Damien
description: As Cartman celebrates his birthday, Jesus Christ and Satan duke it out on a pay-per-view TV special. Meanwhile, Satan's son Damien tries to fit in with the crowd after making a violent first impression.

title: Starvin Marvin
description: After the boys contact an agency that helps starving children, Government authorities send Cartman to Ethiopia. Meanwhile, the town holds a drive for canned goods; and turkeys revolt against a genetic engineer.

title: Mr Hankey the Christmas Poo
description: Because he's Jewish, Kyle is denied involvement in the Nativity play and excluded from trips to see Santa. Meanwhile, South Park residents try to plan a politically correct celebration; and Mr. Hankey visits Kyle.

title: Tom's Rhinoplasty
description: Mr. Garrison takes a leave of absence to have a nose job and is replaced by Miss Ellen, a substitute who threatens Stan and Wendy's relationship.

title: Mecha Streisand
description: The future of the world is at stake after the boys unearth a prehistoric relic that spawns a monster.

title: Cartman's Mom Is a Dirty Slut
description: When Cartman begins to exhibit odd behavior, a counselor suggests that finding his father may solve his problems.

title: Terrance and Phillip in Not Without My Anus
description: An episode featuring Terrance and Phillip, who must save Canada from Saddam Hussein.

title: Cartman's Mom Is Still a Dirty Slut
description: Chef and the boys rush to the hospital to check on Mephesto, who's gunned down just as he's set to reveal the identity of Cartman's father. Meanwhile, the townspeople search for the gunman and battle a snowstorm.

title: Chickenlover
description: Chaos ensues on the streets of South Park as the town is overcome by a crime wave that leaves scores of chickens assaulted. And Officer Barbrady's no help...because he's resigned.

title: Ike's Wee Wee
description: The boys try to circumvent a delicate surgical procedure set to be performed on Kyle's brother as part of a tradition begun by their Jewish ancestors. Meanwhile, Mr. Mackey is cut from his job after he botches a lecture on drugs.

title: Conjoined Fetus Lady
description: Kyle's terrified after an injury sustained during a dodgeball game sends him to the nurse---a conjoined twin with an unusual medical condition. Meanwhile, Pip leads the dodgeball team to the world championships in China.

title: The Mexican Staring Frog of Southern Sri Lanka
description: Jimbo and Ned launch a TV hunting show, which goes head-to-head with "Jesus and Pals," the popular cable-access series.

title: City on the Edge of Forever
description: The boys put twists on events such as the attempted assassination of a talk-show host and a fight with Death as their bus hangs off a cliff. Meanwhile, Ms. Crabtree finds fame when she goes to look for help.

title: Summer Sucks
description: The mayor devises a plan to make the town's Fourth of July celebration memorable, despite a ban on fireworks; and Mr. Hat vanishes, causing Mr. Garrison to visit a therapist.

title: Chef's Salty Chocolate Balls
description: Hollywood pooh-bahs in town for a film festival try to sign Mr. Hankey to a movie deal after their upscale cuisine disrupts the sewage system and nearly destroys him. Meanwhile, locals are up in arms over the movie-industry event.

title: Chickenpox
description: The town faces an outbreak of chicken pox.

title: Roger Ebert Should Lay Off the Fatty Foods
description: Stan, Kyle and Kenny gravitate toward a new planetarium; and Cartman auditions to be the star of "Les Miserables."

title: Clubhouses
description: The boys each build a clubhouse---and Stan is eager to have Wendy over for a game of "truth or dare." However, his parents' separation interferes with his plans.

title: Cow Days
description: During South Park's annual rodeo, the boys compete in a bull-riding contest. Meanwhile, the cows find religion.

title: Chef Aid
description: Chef invites some of his well-known musician friends to participate in a benefit concert after he loses all of his money in a lawsuit. Meanwhile, the boys join the workforce to help him get out of debt.

title: Spooky Fish
description: Stan fears his pet fish may be involved with a rash of unsolved murders that occur on Halloween. Meanwhile, Cartman starts killing people---with kindness, even going so far as to appreciate Wendy's liberal views.

title: Merry Christmas Charlie Manson
description: The boys go to Cartman's grandmother's house for a holiday feast that's also attended by Cartman's uncle (an escaped con) and the police.

title: Gnomes
description: The boys work on a project with a high-strung kid whose parents' coffee shop faces strong competition from a conglomerate that hopes to set up in South Park.

title: Prehistoric Ice Man
description: The boys unearth a prehistoric man frozen in ice, but the discovery jeopardizes Stan and Kyle's friendship when they argue over what to name him.

title: Rainforest Schmainforest
description: The boys accompany a teacher and her singing-and-dancing group to Central America to raise awareness of the rain forest. Also: Kenny falls for a choir member; and Kyle has trouble mastering the choreography.

title: Spontaneous Combustion
description: Residents start to spontaneously combust, prompting Stan's geologist father to investigate.

title: The Succubus
description: Chef gets a visit from his mother when the boys feel his bride-to-be has taken their place in his heart.

title: Tweek vs Craig
description: The boys take a shop class taught by an eccentric, and urge a schoolyard fight between classmates Tweek and Craig.

title: Jakovasaurs
description: The boys discover two nearly extinct animals while camping on the banks of Stark's Pond.

title: Sexual Harassment Panda
description: Cartman sues Stan for sexual harassment.

title: Cat Orgy
description: Shelly baby-sits Cartman.

title: Two Guys Naked in a Hot Tub
description: A meteor shower hits town, and Stan's sister Shelly babysits Cartman while Mrs. Cartman goes to a "meteor party."

title: Jewbilee
description: Kyle and Ike go on a camping trip while South Park residents wait for a meteor shower to begin.

title: Chinpokomon
description: Adults try to counter when the town's children become obsessed with a fad from Japan, whose government reveals their master plan behind the craze.

title: Starvin' Marvin in Space
description: Starvin Marvin returns in a stolen U.S. spaceship, and enlists the boys to help feed his Ethiopian village. The CIA is among their pursuers.

title: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery
description: On Halloween, the boys are plagued by fifth graders and the town is overrun by pirate ghosts. Music group Korn assists, and sings "Falling Away from Me."

title: Hooked on Monkey Fonics
description: Kyle tries to teach his new rival about love; the boys compete against home-schooled kids in the annual spelling bee; and Cartman's mom agrees to teach him at home.

title: The Red Badge of Gayness
description: The town holds its annual reenactment of a Civil War battle, and Cartman suits up for the Confederacy with visions of glory.

title: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics
description: Mr. Hankey and South Park citizens celebrate the holidays with musical numbers from his Christmas Classics Album.

title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jesus
description: "Are You There, God? It's Me, Jesus" purports to "answer age-old questions about who we are and what we're all about."

title: World Wide Recorder Concert
description: The boys and their class travel to the first "Worldwide Recorder Concert" in Arkansas, where Mr. Garrison confronts the demons of his childhood while visiting his parents.

title: Cartman's Silly Hate Crime 2000
description: Cartman is sentenced to juvenile hall and his friends plan to get him out. Meanwhile, he begins to adjust to life on the inside.

title: The Tooth Fairy's Tats 2000
description: Cartman impersonates the Tooth Fairy when he learns there's money to be made from harvesting the teeth of underprivileged kids. However, the leader of a dentists' organization sets out to stop him.

title: Quintuplets 2000
description: The South Park media showers attention on a family with quintuplets that moves into the area, and Cartman befriends one of the new residents. Meanwhile, Kenny's mom tries to cash in on the excitement by planning a multiple birth of her own.

title: Timmy 2000
description: Mr. Mackey excuses Timmy from homework when he mistakenly thinks the boy is suffering from Attention Deficit Disorder; then Cartman and his friends try to develop the same affliction.

title: Pip (A.K.A. Great Expectations)
description: The boys' British classmate, Pip, stars in this spoof of Dickens' classic "Great Expectations," set in London.

title: Cartman Joins NAMBLA
description: Cartman seeks online companionship from older users after deciding that Stan, Kenny and Kyle aren't mature enough.

title: Cherokee Hair Tampons
description: Kyle suffers from a rare kidney disease and Cartman may be the only one who can save him, but at a high price.

title: Chef Goes Nanners
description: Chef protests against the South Park flag and ignites a town debate that even divides the kids. Meanwhile, Wendy becomes attracted to Cartman.

title: Something You Can Do With Your Finger
description: Stan, Kyle, Kenny and Cartman form their own band and hold tryouts for a fifth member.

title: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell?
description: The boys, scared by Priest Maxi's threats of eternal damnation, scramble to take part in Holy Communion and their first Confession in order to "save" themselves.

title: Probably
description: Satan can't decide between his new boyfriend and his former beau, Saddam Hussein. Meanwhile, Cartman has discovered his evangelical side and tries to ensure the gang a passage to heaven.

title: 4th Grade
description: The fearful boys speculate on the identity of their teacher as they begin the fourth grade, leading them to build a time machine to take them back to the safety of third grade.

title: Trapper Keeper
description: Mr. Garrison orders a recount when the race for kindergarten president is too close to call. Meanwhile, a life form from the future appears in the school yard at South Park Elementary.

title: Helen Keller! The Musical
description: The boys work on a Thanksgiving pageant about Helen Keller and decide to use a turkey instead of a dog.

title: Fat Camp
description: Cartman is sent to a camp for obese youngsters by concerned family and friends. Meanwhile, Kenny has his own hit TV show, "Krazy Kenny." Also, Chef talks to the boys about prostitution.

title: The Wacky Molestation Adventure
description: Cartman becomes South Park's mayor when the kids take over the town.

title: A Very Crappy Christmas
description: The boys make a video Christmas card when Mr. Hankey's visit is delayed.

title: Scott Tenorman Must Die
description: Radiohead plays a role in Cartman's plan for revenge against an eighth-grader who wronged him.

title: It Hits the Fan
description: The boys realize they may have made history of some sort when Cartman utters an expletive.

title: Cripple Fight
description: The boys join the Mountain Scouts with Timmy, who winds up in a fight with Jimmy in a supermarket parking lot.

title: The Super Best Friends
description: A magician persuades Kenny, Cartman and Kyle to join his cult, and their journey lands them in Washington, D.C.

title: Terrance and Phillip Behind the Blow
description: The boys are devastated to learn that their heroes Terrence and Phillip have broken up.

title: Cartmanland
description: Cartman uses his $1 million inheritance to open his own amusement park.

title: Proper Condom Use
description: The impulsive implementation of sex-education classes at school leads to an all-out battle between the boys and the girls.

title: Towelie
description: The gang tries to protect a new resident in South Park from the government.

title: Osama bin Laden Has Farty Pants
description: The boys decide to get into the patriotic spirit by heeding the President's advice to send money to the children of Afghanistan. But their spirits sour when they receive a package back and their mail becomes the focus of Government investigators.

title: How to Eat With Your Butt
description: As a prank, Cartman somehow gets Kenny's picture pasted on milk cartons as a missing child, which soon backfires on him.

title: The Entity
description: Kyle is embarrassed by his cousin, Kyle, and tries to think of ways to avoid him in front of his friends.

title: Here Comes the Neighborhood
description: Kyle, Stan, Kenny and Cartman have a run-in with Token, the town's only rich kid. In retaliation, Token encourages other wealthy people to move into the neighborhood.

title: Kenny Dies
description: Cartman discovers the benefits of stem-cell research.

title: Butters' Very Own Episode
description: Butters looks forward to his parents' anniversary dinner despite his mother's reaction to his father's secret extracurricular activities.

title: Freak Strike
description: The gang decides to put Butters up as a guest on a talk show thinking that they will get special favors.

title: Jared Has Aides
description: The gang seizes upon an opportunity to make money with a weight-loss program that's sweeping the country.

title: Asspen
description: The boys head to Aspen, where the slopes are superb and Stan gets into a showdown with the lodge's expert skier.

title: The New Terrance & Phillip Movie Trailer
description: The boys look forward to the newest Terrance and Phillip movie.

title: Fun With Veal
description: After learning how veal is made, the boys try to save some calves from the slaughterhouse.

title: Professor Chaos
description: When Butters is rejected by the kids, his alter ego Professor Chaos is unleashed.

title: Simpsons Already Did it
description: Cartman and the gang fear that they may have accidentally caused a death.

title: Red Hot Catholic Love
description: A priest visits South Park to find out why church attendance is down; the boys protest the tinkering of their favorite movies.

title: Free Hat
description: The boys try to prevent filmmakers from remaking their movies, but their efforts are mistaken for a campaign for the release of an infamous criminal.

title: Bebe's Boobs Destroy Society
description: When Bebe starts to mature physically, the boys behave so boorishly that their friendships are almost ruined.

title: Child Abduction is Not Funny
description: Media stories about kidnappings drive South Park parents to extreme measures, such as building a wall around the town to keep out predators.

title: A Ladder to Heaven
description: Trying to find Kenny in Heaven, the boys discover that Saddam Hussein may have hidden weapons there.

title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
description: While returning "The Lord of the Rings" to the video store, the boys accidentally get a hold of a steamy porno tape.

title: The Death Camp of Tolerance
description: The boys are sent to a camp where cultural sensitivity is taught.

title: The Biggest Douche in the Universe
description: Cartman takes desperate measures to try to rid himself of Kenny's spirit, including traveling to Scotland.

title: My Future Self n' Me
description: Stan is forced to look at his life 30 years in the future; Cartman tries to launch a new business.

title: Red Sleigh Down
description: Cartman tries to score some points with Santa Claus by asking him to deliver presents to the needy children in Iraq.

title: I'm a Little Bit Country
description: The foul-mouthed youngsters return for a seventh season.

title: Krazy Kripples
description: The kids become embroiled in the life of a disabled celebrity who breezes through town and gets all the attention.

title: Toilet Paper
description: The boys are under investigation for covering their teacher's house with toilet paper.

title: Cancelled
description: The boys are abducted by aliens, who inform them that Earth is actually a reality show that is about to be canceled by intergalactic media moguls.

title: Fat Butt and Pancake Head
description: Jennifer Lopez and Ben Affleck come to town.

title: Lil' Crime Stoppers
description: The guys start their own detective agency.

title: Red Man's Greed
description: The boys try to save the town from developers.

title: South Park Is Gay!
description: The whole town suddenly discovers it's all the rage to be gay.

title: Christian Rock Hard
description: Cartman puts together a band; Stan, Kyle and Kenny get into trouble for downloading music from the Internet.

title: Grey Dawn
description: The boys try to have South Park's senior citizens stripped of their driver's licenses after they go on a dangerous rampage.

title: Casa Bonita
description: Cartman seeks revenge for not being invited to Kyle's birthday outing.

title: All About the Mormons
description: Mormon neighbors move into town, causing the citizens of South Park to become Mormons themselves.

title: Butt Out
description: The guys rebel after an anti-smoking campaign begins at their school.

title: Raisins
description: When Stan's girlfriend breaks up with him, his friends try to cheer him up by bringing him to a local restaurant where lovely ladies hang out.

title: It's Christmas in Canada
description: Ike's Canadian birth parents come back to claim him, prompting the residents of South Park to collect money to get him back.

title: Good Times With Weapons
description: After buying some martial arts objects at a market, the boys turn into Japanese warriors to take on their enemy, Prof. Chaos.

title: AWESOM-O
description: Cartman disguises himself as a robot so he can learn secrets about Butters to use against him.

title: Up the Down Steroid
description: Steroids become an issue as Timmy, Jimmy and Cartman train for a sporting event.

title: The Passion of the Jew
description: "The Passion of the Christ" has an unusual effect on Stan, Cartman, Kyle and Kenny.

title: You Got F'd in the A
description: Stan tries to put together a group of competitive dancers to challenge some rivals from Orange County.

title: Goobacks
description: South Park becomes flooded with time travelers from the future.

title: The Jeffersons
description: A mysterious gentleman and his son create controversy in South Park.

title: Douche and Turd
description: The kids have to choose a new mascot after an animal-rights group protests.

title: Something Wall Mart This Way Comes
description: South Park is invaded by a giant shopping center that threatens the quiet little town.

title: Pre School
description: Cartman, Butters, Kenny, Stan and Kyle fear that a secret may get out when an old adversary turns up in town.

title: Quest for Ratings
description: Cartman becomes a network honcho when he and the boys launch a morning news show on the school's closed-circuit TV station.

title: Stupid Spoiled Whore Video Playset
description: South Park is abuzz over a visit from a famous socialite.

title: Cartman's Incredible Gift
description: Cartman is imbued with the power to see into the future after he's hit on the head.

title: Woodland Critter Christmas
description: Woodland creatures ask Stan to help them build a manger.

title: Mr. Garrison's Fancy New Vagina
description: In the season 9 premiere, Mr. Garrison looks to become a woman, and Kyle works in improving his basketball skills.

title: Die Hippie, Die
description: Hippies, the bane of Cartman's existence, threaten to overrun South Park when they plan a weeklong music festival in town.

title: Wing
description: Cartman, Kenny, Stan and Kyle become talent agents with one client.

title: Best Friends Forever
description: Kenny is able to purchase a gaming device that's been sold out, straining his friendship with Cartman.

title: The Losing Edge
description: The boys become bored with baseball after a long winning streak.

title: The Death of Eric Cartman
description: Butters believes he can talk to the dead.

title: Erection Day
description: Jimmy has trouble controlling his hormones right before the big talent show.

title: Two Days Before the Day After Tomorrow
description: The town of Beaverton is flooded when a mammoth beaver dam breaks. Is global warming to blame? Only Stan and Cartman know for sure.

title: Marjorine
description: The boys decide to fake Butters' death and resurrect him as a girl.

title: Follow That Egg!
description: Townsfolk rally against gay marriage, especially Mr. Garrison, whose ex Mr. Slave plans to wed Big Gay Al.

title: Ginger Kids
description: Ostracized for his appearance because of a case of "gingervitus," Cartman goes on a campaign against discrimination.

title: Trapped in the Closet
description: Religious leaders think Stan is the "Golden Child," prompting believers to camp in front of his house.

title: Free Willzyx
description: Kyle bonds with a marine-park whale and gets the boys to help try to return the creature to its family.

title: Bloody Mary
description: After his drunken-driving arrest, Stan's dad believes a visit to a bleeding statue of the Virgin Mary will cure his drinking problem.

title: The Return of Chef
description: Chef Jerome McElroy returns, though the kids notice he's not quite the same.

title: Smug Alert!
description: Stan leads a campaign to purchase hybrid cars, but it stalls when an environmental disaster threatens the town.

title: Cartoon Wars Part I
description: Kyle and Cartman race to Hollywood, with the fate of Kyle's favorite cartoon, "Family Guy," at stake.

title: Cartoon Wars Part II
description: Kyle is injured and Cartman must forge on alone, determined to stop the makers of "Family Guy."

title: A Million Little Fibers
description: Oprah picks Towelie's memoir for her book club, but his account is found to be less than truthful. Soon, the public derision lures Towelie off the wagon.

title: ManBearPig
description: Cartman finds treasure when the boys get stuck in a cave.

title: Tsst
description: Cartman's mom employs the Dog Whisperer to help curb her son's behavioral problems.

title: Make Love Not Warcraft
description: The gang attempts to save the online game World of Warcraft after it is taken over by a renegade gamer.

title: Mystery of the Urinal Deuce
description: The gang discovers who's responsible for the 9/11 attacks and realizes South Park may be in danger.

title: Miss Teacher Bangs a Boy
description: Cartman is tapped to be the new hallway monitor and takes offense when Kyle discovers a teacher is having an affair with a student in his jurisdiction.

title: Hell on Earth 2006
description: Satan tries to plan a Halloween party while dealing with a religious group, an ex-lover and mischievous serial killers.

title: Go God Go
description: South Park residents clash over the teaching of evolution. Meanwhile, Cartman attempts time travel so he can play a soon-to-be-released video-game system.

title: Go God Go XII
description: Cartman tries to escape a dystopian future plagued by militant otters and a lack of video games.

title: Stanley's Cup
description: Stan Marsh has hit rock bottom. He's got no job, no bicycle and his only way out of a bad situation is to coach the local pee wee hockey team. Once a hotshot pee wee hockey player himself, Marsh has tried to put those days behind him. But he's still living with the memory of how he let his team down when he missed the winning shot in the big game. Now, he's about to find out that being a coach means facing your past. He's determined to show his kids what it's like to be winners!

title: With Apologies to Jesse Jackson
description: Randy Marsh is publicly chastised for using the N-word on national television. Meanwhile, Cartman clashes with a little person.

title: Cartman Sucks
description: Butters is sent to a religious camp that promotes a heterosexual lifestyle.

title: Lice Capades
description: th Park Elementary deals with a head-lice scare, and Cartman looks to expose the kids with infected scalps.

title: The Snuke
description: lary Clinton makes a campaign stop in South Park. Meanwhile, Cartman believes he's uncovered a terrorist plot.

title: Fantastic Easter Special
description: Stan searches for the origins of egg decorating, and falls in with a strange society guarding an infamous secret.

title: D-Yikes!
description: Ms. Garrison gets dumped again, so the boys decide to hire someone to remedy the situation.

title: Night of the Living Homeless
description: The homeless population is on the rise in South Park. Both the adults and children go to work looking for solutions to the problem.

title: Le Petit Tourette
description: Cartman pretends to have Tourette's syndrome in order to say whatever he wants.

title: More Crap
description: Randy Marsh becomes a local hero after passing a sizable bowel movement. Later, he contacts a record-keeping society to find out if he has surpassed the world record.

title: Imaginationland
description: The boys enter a dimension containing the world's imagination. Before long, the government taps them for intelligence.

title: Imaginationland Episode II
description: Pentagon officials pressure Kyle and Stan to reveal how they gained access to Imaginationland. Meanwhile, Cartman searches for Kyle in order to make him fulfill his side of the leprechaun bet.

title: Imaginationland Episode III
description: Stan and Butters attempt to escape Imaginationland before the government detonates a nuclear device in the alternate dimension. Meanwhile, Cartman takes his bet with Kyle to the Supreme Court.

title: Guitar Queer O
description: Stan and Kyle become a successful Guitar Hero duo. After they part ways, Stan succumbs to the pitfalls of rock stardom.

title: The List
description: The boys discover a secret list compiled by their female classmates that rates them according to looks.

title: Tonsil Trouble
description: In the 12th-season premiere, Cartman faces an uncertain future after a routine tonsillectomy reveals a more serious condition.

title: Britney's New Look
description: The boys meet Britney Spears while she's on a search for seclusion in the Colorado mountains, and Stan and Kyle eventually take on the responsibility of getting her to the North Pole.

title: Major Boobage
description: Suspicions by friends and family of Kenny's drug use play out in an homage to the 1981 animated fantasy "Heavy Metal."

title: Canada on Strike
description: When Canada goes on strike, the boys find themselves in the thick of negotiations for a settlement, and the void in U.S. jobs is filled by replacements from Denmark. Meanwhile, Terrance and Phillip are on the fence about joining the strike, but are shocked by its fiscal consequences.

title: Eek, a Penis!
description: Cartman takes over Ms. Garrison's class when the teacher's personal crisis causes her to be removed from the classroom.

title: Over Logging
description: When a lack of Internet access in South Park sparks panic in the community, Randy takes his family to California in search of a signal.

title: Super Fun Time
description: A class trip to a living museum that recreates 1800s Colorado leads to a hostage situation for some of the boys.

title: The China Problem
description: Butters stands with Cartman as he confronts the Chinese after a tragic event.

title: Breast Cancer Show Ever
description: Wendy courts trouble when she vows to beat up Cartman after school.

title: Pandemic
description: Cartman enlists the help of rival Craig when the boys spot an easy opportunity for financial gain from a global crisis.

title: Pandemic 2: The Startling
description: The boys discover the reason for the global attacks by oversize guinea pigs, but first they have to find their way out of the Andes.

title: About Last Night...
description: South Park residents join the rest of the country in celebrating the election of a U.S. president, who moves a new administration into the White House ahead of schedule.

title: Elementary School Musical
description: The boys are startled to learn that their popularity at school is waning when they fail to submit to the latest fad, which actually makes Butters cooler than they are.

title: The Ungroundable
description: In the 12th-season finale, vampire sightings at school anger the Goth kids, who are upset when they become indistinguishable from the bloodsucking interlopers in the eyes of their peers.

title: The Ring
description: In the 13th-season premiere, Kenny gets less than he bargained for when he takes his new girlfriend to a Jonas Brothers concert.

title: The Coon
description: Rival vigilantes battle for supremacy as crime-fighting icons of the town.

title: Margaritaville
description: Randy's solution to fix the economy finds enthusiastic support in the community and revolutionizes the way people live their lives.

title: Eat, Pray, Queef
description: An April Fools' joke goes bad, inspiring fear and fury among the boys.

title: Fishsticks
description: Cartman helps Jimmy with a comedy routine that becomes the sensation of the year until it's time to take credit for the joke.

title: Pinewood Derby
description: Randy pulls out all the stops to make sure that Stan wins first place in the annual Pinewood Derby

title: Fatbeard
description: Buoyed by news of pirates in Somalia, Cartman hatches a plan to run away to live the life of a buccaneer.

title: Dead Celebrities
description: Kyle seeks help from paranormal experts when his little brother is haunted by ghosts.

title: Butters' Bottom Bitch
description: Butters hopes his first kiss will put an end to his friends' ridicule.

title: W.T.F.
description: The boys aspire to be professional wrestlers after seeing their first match live.

title: Whale Whores
description: Stan vows to save the dolphins after a family visit to an aquarium in Denver on his birthday is marred by a mass slaughter of aquatic mammals.

title: The F Word
description: The boys take action when a motorcycle festival takes over the town.

title: Dances With Smurfs
description: Cartman is selected to read the morning announcements at school, but he turns the forum into a bully pulpit to unleash criticism of the student-body president.

title: Pee
description: In the 13th-season finale, the boys' trip to a local water park comes with apocalyptic overtones.

title: Sexual Healing
description: In the 14th-season premiere, scientific testing reveals that some of the fourth-grade boys are sex addicts.

title: The Tale of Scrotie Mcboogerballs
description: After being assigned to read a book that was once banned, the boys are inspired to collaborate on one of their own.

title: Medicinal Fried Chicken
description: When a store selling medical marijuana opens on the site of Cartman's favorite fried-chicken joint, Randy is first in line to buy some weed. But he can't because he's completely healthy. Meanwhile, Cartman will stop at nothing to get the restaurant back.

title: You Have 0 Friends
description: Kyle turns to Stan for help with a Facebook crisis.
South Park is the target of a class-action lawsuit on behalf of all the vengeful celebrities who have been mocked by the town.
The identity of Cartman's dad is on everyone's mind despite threats from the ginger kids about Muhammad and enraged celebrities who have harnessed the power of Mecha Streisand.

title: Crippled Summer
description: Jimmy and Timmy go to summer camp with a winner-take-all attitude in a variety of contests, including Jimmy's participation in a surfing competition. Towelie faces an intervention for his addictions.

title: Poor and Stupid
description: Cartman's dream to become a NASCAR driver comes true, with Butters as his pit boss.

title: It's a Jersey Thing
description: Randy spearheads the town's defense when "Jersey Shore"-inspired Garden State residents are threatening to take over the entire country.

title: Insheeption
description: Stan talks to Mr. Mackey about his hoarding disorder, but learns the guidance counselor has problems with the same compulsion.

title: Coon 2: Hindsight
description: The Coon leads a group of crimefighters who spring into action to help victims of another drilling catastrophe in the Gulf.

title: Mysterion Rises
description: The identity of Mysterion is revealed when the Coon, abandoned by his crime-fighting cohorts, seeks revenge in the Gulf.

title: Coon vs. Coon & Friends
description: Cthulhu does Cartman's bidding, leaving Coon & Friends at his mercy; Kenny's curse presents a dilemma.

Meanwhile, Principal Victoria and Mr. Garrison return to a South Park that has become unrecognizable
